facts.fact: CIVIX (Cote d'Ivoire Internet Exchange), the national exchange point, has been operational for more than a decade and federates telecom operators and ISPs, per Fraternite Matin reporting the ARTCI PeeringDay 2026 in Abidjan.
Traffic: 36 Gbps (average daily) at CIVIX on 2026-06-15, as stated at the ARTCI PeeringDay 2026; the article gives no measurement date, so the forum date is used.
Netflix and Akamai are among the international content players that CIVIX federates alongside operators and ISPs, per the article on PeeringDay 2026.

facts.fact: CIVIX, the national exchange point created in July 2013, has 14 connected operators and providers, per ARTCI at its first peering forum in Abidjan.
Traffic: 20 Gbps (average, per day) at CIVIX on 2025-08-05, as stated by ARTCI at the first Ivorian peering forum.

facts.fact: The minister said the national exchange point CIVIX keeps about 25% of national traffic local, with an aim of 50% by 2026.
ARTCI says Akamai was integrated into the CIVIX exchange point, in service since October 2013, and that Netflix and PCH now connect there alongside local operators.
